title: Pitch Music & Arts Unveils 2027 Lineup for 10th Anniversary Edition
summary: CHRIS STASSY, Chlär, CLOUDY, Peach, Patrick Mason, HAAi and X CLUB. among the artists heading to Victoria’s Grampians in March 2027.
contentText:
Pitch Music & Arts has unveiled the lineup for its 10th edition, with CHRIS STASSY, Chlär, CLOUDY, Peach, Patrick Mason, HAAi and X CLUB. among the artists heading to Victoria’s Grampians in March 2027.

The electronic music and arts festival will return to the foothills of Gariwerd from March 5-9, marking a decade since its launch in 2017. The anniversary lineup brings together international club names, returning Pitch favorites and a large contingent of Australian artists across house, techno, breakbeat, jungle, trance and other corners of electronic music.

Dutch DJ and producer CHRIS STASSY leads the international bill, returning to Australia after releasing his debut album, Lost, Found & Forgotten… . The producer, formerly known as Chris Stussy before adopting the CHRIS STASSY name earlier this year, will be joined by Swiss techno producer Chlär, French producer SWEELY and Canadian-born, London-based DJ Peach.

Germany’s CLOUDY and Patrick Mason are also on the bill, alongside Brazilian DJ and producer Clementaum, Scottish duo Clouds and Berlin-based Malugi. Denis Sulta will return to Pitch after delivering the festival’s closing set in 2019, while Hiroko Yamamura, Yanamaste, Fafi Abdel Nour, dj sweet6teen and Clara Cuvé are among the other international artists announced.

Australia’s electronic scene is heavily represented across the anniversary program. London-based HAAi returns following the release of DIGITiSE , while X CLUB. will perform two separate sets during the festival.

DJ BORING joins the lineup ahead of his debut album, Radio Silence , while Kia, Connor Wall, Aldonna and Reptant will make their Pitch debuts. Wax’o Paradiso, Soju Gang, Moopie b2b Miki, DAWS b2b Mikalah Watego, Roka, Tangerine and YESNA are also among the homegrown acts appearing.

Pitch’s three custom-built stages — Pitch One, the Resident Advisor Stage and Pitch Black — will return for the 2027 edition, along with the festival’s Sunrise Set.

The anniversary edition will also feature a series of stage takeovers. Bitter Ivy, Chuleo Club, Hide The Junk and Ultraviolet will take over Pitch’s main stages, while Mob Ties, of the Essence, Radio Cazimi, Solace Radio, The Breakfast Club and World Dance will appear at The Rock Pool.

Away from the main dancefloors, The Rock Pool and Pitch Pavilion will return, while Anna Nalpantidis will serve as arts curator for a second consecutive year.

The 2027 event follows Pitch’s ninth edition earlier this year and marks another milestone for promoter Untitled Group, whose Australian festival portfolio also includes Beyond The Valley, Wildlands and Ability Fest.

Two-, three- and four-day passes will be available, with general camping included. Premium camping, pre-pitched tents and glamping options will also be offered, alongside transport services from Melbourne and Ararat.

Presale registration closes Tuesday, Oct. 27, at 4 p.m. AEDT, with the Pitch presale beginning at 6 p.m. General tickets go on sale Wednesday, Oct. 28, at noon AEDT.
